_comment: Attach to the ECS EXECUTION role (executionRoleArn in ecs/task-definition-metrics.json) AND the Batch execution role (executionRoleArn in batch/job-definition-metrics.json) -- what ECS/Batch itself assumes to pull the image and set up logging, before your code runs. Same split-from-the-task-role reasoning as fargate_execution_role_policy.json. No ReadTmdbApiKeySecret statement here (unlike the validator's) -- poster-metrics-pipeline never needs a TMDB API key, it only hits TMDB's public image CDN.
